text:
maria: Quick heads-up — finalizing the press availability grid for the Monday launch. Need EOD confirmations for EU/APAC slots and a single source for quote + fact checks. Assigning owners now. @owen @elaine @sanjay

owen: Monday already 😬. I can coordinate schedules. Question: can we agree a simple "fact-audit cascade" (PR -> Product -> Legal) so approvals are consistent? Who owns the chain?

elaine: I can own PR confirms. Preferred flow: PR -> Product -> Legal. Legal only for metric/claim changes. We should timestamp approvals and keep a single file with signed-off lines.

sanjay: Product can do metric checks. I'll compile benchmark numbers and short method note (test harness, dataloader seed) — ETA tomorrow 3pm PT.

kevin: Sales wants a locked, short quote for briefings (one-liner + metric). Can PR draft a fallback quote if Product misses deadline?

pressbot: Embargo scheduling reminder: windows are 09:00 PT / 16:00 UTC / 00:00 AEST. Autounlock will fire if approvals not present 60m prior. Set up alerts.

maria: Thanks. I'll create the grid and attach. Quick CSV snapshot (working):

```
slot_id,timezone,start,end,contact,status
1,PT,09:00,09:30,elaine,open
2,UTC,16:00,16:30,owen,open
3,AEST,00:00,00:30,maria,open
4,APAC-early,07:00,07:20,sanjay,open
```

maria: Notes: slots are staggered to allow quote updates after product sign-off. If product numbers change, we move media to later slots or push a corrected note.

elaine: Suggest fallback quote approved by comms: "Redwood Inference makes serving predictable at scale." short + generic, legal-lite. Use only if metrics not cleared.

owen: For inbound analyst routing during embargo, propose single alias press+launch@redwood.ai -> triage to comms rota. Who can monitor first 2 hours?

elaine: I can cover first 2 hours, then handoff to the comms rota. Need a 1-sheet cheat for spokes and embargo do/don't lists.

sanjay: Sending draft numbers now (DRAFT): top-line latency improvement: 2.3x; median p95 decreased 40%; cost per token down ~30% using batch+cache. All from internal harness v3. Will add test details for legal.

kevin: I'll prep the inbound routing doc and a canned Q&A sheet in GH (placeholder link: https://github.com/redwood/press-ops/blob/launch/cheatsheet.md) — will add signal for high-touch analysts.

owen: Can we do a dry-run Friday 09:00 PT with spokes and one mock analyst? If flow works, I'll lock the grid and publish embargo recipient list to the press kit.

maria: Action items: Elaine owns PR confirmations & watches inbox first 2h; Sanjay finalizes metrics by 3pm PT tomorrow; Owen runs Friday dry-run; Kevin builds inbound alias + cheat sheet; Maria will update the CSV grid and ping again.

maria: Also: please avoid publishing exact dataset names in the press kit until legal signs off on privacy language. We'll keep method note high-level in external docs.

owen: Got it. I'll schedule dry-run and share calendar invites after Sanjay's 3pm update.

elaine: +1. Will draft fallback quote in the doc now and mark as "comms-approved" if it's acceptable.

kevin: prepping routing + short FAQ, ETA EOD.

maria: Perfect — thanks team :thumbsup: 

pressbot: Automated reminder scheduled: dry-run Friday 09:00 PT (invite sent).
